notes.title: The 6th Grimoire Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[h1][b]A new Grimoire has been added![/b][/h1][p]Unlock Condition: Achieve 13 wins with any Grimoire.[/p][p][/p][p]A brand-new deck featuring new cards has been added, marking the arrival of the 6th Grimoire.
Discover and master new cards and links to challenge your battles.
You may even encounter something reminiscent of [i]that card[/i] you always wanted to use but couldn’t.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Patch Notes v1.3.0[/b][/h2][p][b]NEW[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the 6th Grimoire[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugfix[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted certain card abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues related to card operations[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted enemy AI appearance rates[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [h2]Patch Notes v1.2.2[/h2][p][b]BUGFIX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug with the probability of "Ancient Armament".[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: A New Grimoire Has Been Added!
notes.content: [h1][b]A New Grimoire Has Been Added![/b][/h1][p][b]Unlock Condition:[/b] Achieve a total of 50 victories.[/p][p]A brand-new grimoire has been added, featuring approximately 40 new cards and around 60 new links.[/p][p]Make the most of the unique traits of the new special cards and take on new challenges![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Patch Notes v1.2.0[/b][/p][p][b]New![/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new grimoire[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugfix[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed text for certain cards[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound and effects for certain abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where attack power increased incorrectly after taking damage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with win tracking for the fourth grimoire[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes v1.1.0[/h2][p][/p][p][b][u]A new Grimoire has been added![/u][/b][/p][p]Unlock Condition: Achieve 10 wins with each of the three Grimoires.[/p][p][/p][p]A completely new Grimoire with brand-new cards is planned for a future update.
Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][b]BUGFIX:[/b]
“Fortress” – Fixed the ability’s area of effect.[/p]
